baseGroups.reason: Refined in runtime to the one-way mapping contract → agreement/arrangement; this preserves the narrower-to-broader relationship instead of treating arrangement as an exact synonym.
Consultant is a person while consulting and consultancy name services.
Pay is a verb; payment, remuneration and compensation differ in scope.
US and UK spelling variants are interchangeable.
US and UK spelling variants are interchangeable.
General breach, violation and infringement are close in compliance prose.
US and UK spelling variants are interchangeable.
Surgeon and GP are narrower than physician; clinician and healthcare professional are broader.
A pharmacist or dentist is a healthcare professional but not necessarily a clinician.
These professions are distinct; specialist and clinician are not universal equivalents.
Care team can contain non-professionals; keep role phrases separately precise.
A lab can be a commercial company rather than a healthcare organisation.
These facilities can be healthcare organisations; remove generic institution expansion.
Patient advocacy bodies are narrower instances of patient organisations.
Romantic partners, spouses and companions differ; guest is contextual, not a synonym.
Children and relatives are family, but guest status is contextual.
An unmarried partner is not a spouse; partner is the appropriate broader term.
Refined in runtime: conference forms map to conference, meeting, and event; course and workshop formats map to training and education. These are ordinary-language category relationships.
A trade show or expo is an exhibition, which need not be a conference.
Webinar and online meeting are virtual, but a livestream need not be a meeting.
A roadshow and launch are not necessarily conferences.
Mixer and networking event are social gatherings; generic event adds noise.
Exhibit space and stand can map to booth; generic display adds noise.
Promotional and information stands may map to booth; pop-up stand is ambiguous retail language.
Airline and plane are not airfare; retain ticket fare phrases only.
Rail and taxi are modes; mileage is a cost measure, not transportation.
Upgrade alone is ambiguous; specific class phrases can reach air travel.
Layover, stopover and connecting flight are specific kinds of travel.
Hotel room and overnight lodging are accommodation.
Lodge and inn can be accommodation; hotel should not be imposed on all.
Meals, drinks and catering differ; alcohol is not a meal.
Appetizers and snacks are refreshments; buffet may be a full meal.
Cash bar is customer-paid; all are bar service, not necessarily hospitality support.
Golf and skiing are sports; concert and theatre are entertainment; avoid a shared social event target.
Tour and celebration are ambiguous; nightclub and casino are leisure venues.
Group activity alone may be professional; excursion or team building is clearer.
Honorarium and speaker fee are remuneration; per diem and allowance are expenses.
Refund and reimbursement differ from expense claim; payout is broad.
Bonus and advance payment are different from fee and one another; bare bonus is ambiguous.
Free of charge is not the same as in-kind support.
Gift cards and vouchers are cash equivalents; merchandise is broad, not necessarily a gift.
Thank-you gifts are gifts; branded items may be promotional without being gifts.

Bribe/kickback/backhander expand to bribery, corruption and improper advantage. Ambiguous sweetener and broad induce/inducement targets were removed; all five actual result passages were independently judged relevant.
Payoff may be a bribe but illicit and secret payments need not be inducements.
Charity is an organisation or activity; donate is a verb; separate donation and philanthropic phrases.
Fundraising is not itself a donation; charitable giving is.
Financial support is broader than grant or sponsorship; the two must stay separate.
An adviser may consult; an advisory board is a body, not a consultant.
Speaker and lecturer are faculty; speaking is an activity.
Moderator/chairperson can be faculty; emcee and MC may only host.
Study/trial can be research; survey or investigation need not be clinical research.
Questionnaire and data collection are methods, not necessarily clinical research.
Trial product can mean an evaluation item; free sample is a sample.
A demo unit is a demonstration product.
A loan is an ownership arrangement; evaluation is a purpose and must stay distinct.
Medical textbooks and anatomical models are educational items.
Several listed objects may be personal gifts; distinguish practice items from generic merchandise.
Publishing is an action; disclosure is the content or act. Transparency is broader.
Public register and database are publication channels, not disclosures themselves.
Whistleblowing reports concerns; complaint is a procedural filing; breach is an outcome.
Dispute, objection and concern are not automatically formal complaints.
Suspension and expulsion are sanctions; a fine is not listed here and penalty is broader.
Warning letter and reprimand may be sanctions; blacklist and ban need more context.
Reseller/dealer are distributors; agent and representative are intermediaries, not always distributors.
Broker is an intermediary; representative office is an organisational location.
A patent is intellectual property; a licence fee is not necessarily a royalty.
Copyright and trademark are intellectual property, not royalty payments.
Manager can be superior; employer is the organisation, not the manager.
Resort is a venue; destination is a geographic location, not necessarily a venue.
These are places that can serve as venues.
Hybrid combines in-person and virtual participation; digital/remote events can be virtual.
These are specific kinds of fees.
Scholarships and bursaries can be educational grants but grant is broader.
Named training variants are training or education.
A phone call is not a virtual event; conference calls can be meetings.
Welcome/delegate bags can be gifts, but their content determines item type.
Live demonstration is an activity; demonstration product is a physical item.
An allowance is a payment for meals, not a meal or hospitality itself.
Suite can be a room type without an upgrade; keep explicit upgrade phrases.
Expenses are distinct from reimbursement; personal expenses may be ineligible.
Misconduct/non-compliance may be a breach; complaint is an allegation process.
Investigation outcome can exonerate; corrective action is not always a sanction.
Go-between is an intermediary; fixer/facilitator have broader senses.
Patent royalty is a royalty; usage rights are intellectual property rights, not payments.
Supervisor and department head are superiors; senior management is a group, not employer.
These buildings can serve as venues.
